full_prompt:
Create exactly ONE new original Small Seal script glyph based on the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC are all variants of THE SAME ONE CHARACTER, not separate output characters. Compare ALL available specimens equally to understand the exact identity. Choose ONE coherent attested WHOLE construction if variants differ; never splice incompatible alternatives or default to THX alone. Do not substitute a modern Chinese character.

Trace genuine writing-stroke trajectories as smooth controlled centerline curves. Draw these with exactly CONSTANT uniform thickness approximately 3% of the square canvas width, perfectly rounded caps and joins. No swelling, taper, pointed tips, brush pressure, serif, texture or outline of brush silhouettes. Keep essential branches, short marks, counters, attachments, separations and relative bar lengths explicit. Important small gaps must stay open.

ONE finished glyph centered in the central 70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, charts, grids, frame, four variants, reference copies, shadows, paper, backdrop, ornament or watermark. The structural reading aid below guides attention, while all four reference specimens remain the visual authority.

CHARACTER U+3D046. Essential reading aid: LEFT altar: short detached top dash, longer lower horizontal with long central descending stem, and TWO detached long flank strokes. RIGHT has EXACTLY THREE SEPARATE WRITING STROKES, with zero closed counters. First and largest right stroke is a full-height winding angular reverse-S: start at TOP LEFT of right component, travel RIGHT, turn DOWN at far-right, return LEFT across upper-middle; turn DOWN at left, return RIGHT across lower-middle; then turn DOWN again at far-right to a long lower endpoint. Keep this LARGE OUTER WINDING STROKE; it is essential and must not disappear. SECOND right stroke is a SMALL ⊃ nested inside the UPPER large bend: TWO parallel horizontal legs, free ends on LEFT, joined by rounded RIGHT bend. THIRD right stroke is a SMALL ⊂ nested inside the LOWER large bend: TWO parallel horizontal legs, free ends on RIGHT, joined by rounded LEFT bend. Thus right section has SEVEN visible horizontal levels:3large-stroke runs+2upper-return legs+2lower-return legs. Small returns are NOT plain dashes, and they do not replace the large outer winding stroke. Select coherent THX/QJZ/DYC long lower-tail whole variant after comparing CCZ's shorter-ending alternative. Preserve ALL THREE right components and the big stroke's lower descending tail. Entire glyph has7inkcomponents in this coherent detached construction:4left plus3right. Make space for all details with clear open channels.
